mainline/songjiazhuang#1.zh: 宋江杀了阎婆惜，连夜逃回宋家村，躲进庄上佛堂底下的地窨子。张文远和阎婆在县里连日告闹，知县推托不过，只得差朱仝、雷横两个都头，带土兵来宋家庄搜捉。
mainline/songjiazhuang#1.t: After killing Yan Poxi, Song Jiang fled back to Song Family Village that night and hid in the cellar under the manor's Buddha hall. Zhang Wenyuan and Granny Yan made a fuss at the county court day after day, and the magistrate, unable to put them off, had to send the two constables Zhu Tong and Lei Heng with militia to search the Song manor.

mainline/songjiazhuang#2.zh: 二位都头光降，不知有何公干？
mainline/songjiazhuang#2.t: Constables, you honour us. What business brings you here?

mainline/songjiazhuang#3.zh: 太公休怪。上司差遣，盖不由己。押司如今在何处？
mainline/songjiazhuang#3.t: Forgive us, Squire. We're under orders and have no choice. Where is the Clerk now?

mainline/songjiazhuang#4.zh: 不瞒二位都头说，老汉这孩儿宋江，自小忤逆，不肯本分。前些年老汉已在官府告了他忤逆，出了他的籍，不在老汉户内。现有执凭在此。
mainline/songjiazhuang#4.t: To be honest with you, Constables, my son Song Jiang has been unfilial since he was small and never kept to his place. Some years ago I reported him to the authorities as unfilial and struck him from the family register; he's not in my household. I have the certificate here.

mainline/songjiazhuang#5.zh: 执凭虽有，公文上要我们搜一遍，总得有个交代。朱哥，你看怎地？
mainline/songjiazhuang#5.t: You have the certificate, but our warrant says we must search, and we need something to report. Brother Zhu, what do you think?

mainline/songjiazhuang#6.zh: 我心里不托。雷兄弟，你带土兵守住庄门，休放一个人出去；我自进去仔细搜一搜。
mainline/songjiazhuang#6.t: I'm not easy about it. Brother Lei, take the militia and guard the manor gate; don't let a soul out. I'll go in and search carefully myself.

mainline/songjiazhuang#7.zh: 朱仝独自进了佛堂，把供床拖在一边，揭开底下那片地板，拽动索头的铜铃。不多时，宋江从地窨子里钻了出来。
mainline/songjiazhuang#7.t: Zhu Tong went into the Buddha hall alone, dragged the altar table aside, lifted the floorboard beneath and pulled the cord of the copper bell. Before long Song Jiang crawled out of the cellar.

mainline/songjiazhuang#8.zh: 朱仝贤弟！你……你是来拿我的么？
mainline/songjiazhuang#8.t: Brother Zhu Tong! Have... have you come to arrest me?

mainline/songjiazhuang#9.zh: 公明哥哥，休怪小弟今来捉你。平日只有我和你最好，你曾对我说过这佛座底下的地窨子。我怕雷横执着，不会周全人，因此打发他在庄前，只我自来寻你。
mainline/songjiazhuang#9.t: Brother Gongming, don't blame me for coming to catch you. You and I have always been closest; you once told me about the cellar under this altar. I was afraid Lei Heng would be stubborn and not know how to cover for a man, so I sent him to the front of the manor and came to find you myself.

mainline/songjiazhuang#10.zh: 知县本有周全哥哥的意思，只是张三和阎婆在厅上发言发语，说本县不做主时，定要到州里告状。此处虽好，也不是安身之处；倘被人知得，来这里搜着，如之奈何？
mainline/songjiazhuang#10.t: The magistrate meant to protect you, brother, but Zhang San and Granny Yan made a scene in court, saying that if the county wouldn't act they'd take it to the prefecture. This place is fine, but it's no refuge. If someone found out and came to search here, what then?

mainline/songjiazhuang#11.zh: 我也正这般寻思。小可思量有三处可去：一是沧州横海郡柴大官人庄上，二是青州清风寨小李广花荣处，三是白虎山孔太公庄上。
mainline/songjiazhuang#11.t: I've been thinking the same. I can think of three places to go: Lord Chai's manor in Henghai Prefecture, Cangzhou; 'Little Li Guang' Hua Rong at Qingfeng Fort in Qingzhou; or Squire Kong's manor on White Tiger Mountain.

mainline/songjiazhuang#12.zh: 兄长可作急寻思，当行即行。今晚便可动身，切勿迟延自误。上下官司之事，都在我身上。
mainline/songjiazhuang#12.t: Think quickly, brother, and go when you must. You can leave tonight; don't delay and ruin yourself. I'll take care of everything with the authorities.

mainline/songjiazhuang#13.zh: 朱哥去了这许久……哥哥！原来你果然在庄里。
mainline/songjiazhuang#13.t: Brother Zhu's been gone so long... Brother! So you really were in the manor.

mainline/songjiazhuang#14.zh: 哥哥休慌。哥哥平日待人仗义，我雷横岂肯落井下石？回县只说庄前庄后都搜遍了，没有这个人便是。
mainline/songjiazhuang#14.t: Don't worry, brother. You've always treated people righteously; how could I, Lei Heng, kick a man when he's down? Back at the county we'll just say we searched the manor front and back and you weren't here.

mainline/songjiazhuang#15.zh: 话音未落，庄门外一阵喧嚷。张文远放心不下两个都头，自带了几个泼皮打手闯进庄来，自己却只站在东边墙根下吆喝。
mainline/songjiazhuang#15.t: Before he'd finished, there was a commotion outside the manor gate. Zhang Wenyuan, not trusting the two constables, had burst into the manor with a few thugs, though he himself stayed by the east wall, shouting.

mainline/songjiazhuang#16.t: What... what are we to do!

mainline/songjiazhuang#17.zh: 父亲且回后堂，休要惊着。孩儿自有分晓。
mainline/songjiazhuang#17.t: Go back to the rear hall, Father, and don't be alarmed. I know what to do.

mainline/songjiazhuang#18.zh: 好哇！我便料你两个和宋江交好，必然卖放！凶身就在眼前，你们不拿，我自拿！我家里人随后便到，看你们往哪里走！
mainline/songjiazhuang#18.t: Aha! I knew you two were friends with Song Jiang and would let him go! The murderer is right in front of you. If you won't take him, I will! My household men are right behind me; let's see where you run!

mainline/songjiazhuang#19.zh: 张三！我两个奉公文搜庄，自有分寸。你一个押司，私带打手闯进人家庄院，是何道理？
mainline/songjiazhuang#19.t: Zhang San! We're searching this manor under warrant and know what we're doing. You're a clerk; what do you mean by bringing thugs into a man's manor?

mainline/songjiazhuang#20.zh: 这厮逼人太甚！哥哥且护住自己，待我与朱哥打发了这伙泼皮！
mainline/songjiazhuang#20.t: This fellow goes too far! Brother, look after yourself, and Brother Zhu and I will see off these thugs!

mainline/songjiazhuang#21.zh: 二位贤弟手下留情，莫伤人命。打退他们便罢！
mainline/songjiazhuang#21.t: Go easy, my brothers, don't take any lives. Just drive them off!

mainline/songjiazhuang#22.zh: 张文远见三人动了兵刃，慌忙退出庄门外，只叫打手们上前。
mainline/songjiazhuang#22.t: Seeing the three draw their weapons, Zhang Wenyuan hastily backed out of the manor gate and sent only his thugs forward.

mainline/songjiazhuang#24.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打倒张文远（他躲在庄外，第3回合带人回来）
mainline/songjiazhuang#24.t: Victory --- Defeat Zhang Wenyuan (he hides outside the manor and comes back with men on turn 3)

mainline/songjiazhuang#25.zh: 失败条件   --- 宋江、朱仝、雷横任一人战败，或超过30回合
mainline/songjiazhuang#25.t: Defeat --- Song Jiang, Zhu Tong or Lei Heng is defeated, or more than 30 turns pass

mainline/songjiazhuang#26.zh: 西南边墙外又是一阵脚步声，张文远家里的几个家丁拿着棍棒赶到了。
mainline/songjiazhuang#26.t: More footsteps beyond the southwest wall: some of Zhang Wenyuan's household men had arrived with clubs.

mainline/songjiazhuang#27.t: Don't worry, Third Son, we're here!

mainline/songjiazhuang#28.zh: 后面也来了人……二位贤弟当心，莫教他们前后夹住！
mainline/songjiazhuang#28.t: More are coming from behind... Careful, brothers, don't let them pin us front and back!

mainline/songjiazhuang#29.zh: 东南角门外又涌进来一伙衙役，原来是张文远使了钱，买嘱来的县里差人，还带着弓手。张文远躲在他们身后，又回到了庄里。
mainline/songjiazhuang#29.t: Through the southeast side gate poured a band of yamen runners: county officers Zhang Wenyuan had bribed, with archers too. Zhang Wenyuan came back into the manor hiding behind them.

mainline/songjiazhuang#30.zh: 张押司吩咐了，拿住宋江，赏钱少不了大家的！
mainline/songjiazhuang#30.t: Clerk Zhang's orders: catch Song Jiang and there's a reward for everyone!

mainline/songjiazhuang#31.zh: 你们是县里的公人，倒替张三卖命？擒贼先擒王，先打倒张文远，这伙人自然散了！
mainline/songjiazhuang#31.t: You're county officers, and you risk your necks for Zhang San? To catch the bandits, catch their leader. Bring down Zhang Wenyuan and this lot will scatter!

mainline/songjiazhuang#32.zh: 给我上！谁拿住宋江，我张三另有重赏！
mainline/songjiazhuang#32.t: At them! Whoever catches Song Jiang gets an extra reward from me, Zhang San!

mainline/songjiazhuang#33.zh: 哎哟……哎哟！反了，反了！两个都头放走杀人凶身，还打伤公人！
mainline/songjiazhuang#33.t: Ow... ow! It's rebellion, rebellion! Two constables letting a murderer go, and beating up officers!

mainline/songjiazhuang#34.zh: 宋江，你今日走得脱，明日也走不脱！我便是告到济州府、告到东京，也要告倒你们这一伙！
mainline/songjiazhuang#34.t: Song Jiang, you may get away today, but not tomorrow! I'll take this to Jizhou Prefecture, to the Eastern Capital if I must, and bring down the whole lot of you!

mainline/songjiazhuang#35.zh: 你这厮还敢嘴硬？再啰唆一句，教你爬着回县里去！
mainline/songjiazhuang#35.t: Still mouthing off? One more word and you'll crawl back to the county!

mainline/songjiazhuang#36.zh: 雷兄弟，罢了。张三，你私带打手、买嘱公人闯进人家庄院，这事若闹到知县相公跟前，看是谁吃罪不起。还不快滚！
mainline/songjiazhuang#36.t: Enough, Brother Lei. Zhang San, you brought thugs and bribed officers to break into a man's manor. If this reaches the magistrate, we'll see who can't bear the blame. Now get out!

mainline/songjiazhuang#37.zh: 张文远捂着伤处，连滚带爬逃出庄门；打手、家丁和衙役见主人跑了，也一哄而散。三人收住兵刃，并未追赶。
mainline/songjiazhuang#37.t: Clutching his wounds, Zhang Wenyuan scrambled out of the manor gate. Seeing their master run, the thugs, household men and runners scattered too. The three lowered their weapons and didn't give chase.

mainline/songjiazhuang#38.zh: 这厮回去必定要告我两个。不妨，县里自有我分说。兄长今夜便走，休再耽搁！
mainline/songjiazhuang#38.t: He's sure to bring charges against us two when he gets back. No matter, I'll handle it at the county. Leave tonight, brother, don't delay any longer!

mainline/songjiazhuang#39.zh: 太公这里有我们照看。哥哥只管放心去。
mainline/songjiazhuang#39.t: We'll look after the Squire here. Go, brother, and don't worry.

mainline/songjiazhuang#40.zh: 二位贤弟今日之情，宋江铭记在心。他日有缘，再图相报！
mainline/songjiazhuang#40.t: I, Song Jiang, will never forget what you two have done today. If fate allows, I'll repay you one day!

mainline/songjiazhuang#41.zh: 当夜，宋江与兄弟宋清拜别了宋太公，离了宋家庄，投沧州柴大官人庄上去了。朱仝、雷横回县，只说庄前庄后四围村坊都搜遍了，其实没有这个人。
mainline/songjiazhuang#41.t: That night Song Jiang and his brother Song Qing bade farewell to Squire Song, left the Song manor and set out for Lord Chai's manor in Cangzhou. Zhu Tong and Lei Heng returned to the county and said they had searched the manor and all the surrounding villages, and the man wasn't there.

mainline/songjiazhuang#42.zh: 宋江离了宋家庄，投奔柴进去了！
mainline/songjiazhuang#42.t: Song Jiang leaves the Song manor to seek refuge with Chai Jin!

mainline/songjiazhuang#43.zh: 宋江战败，宋江没能脱身……
mainline/songjiazhuang#43.t: Song Jiang was defeated and couldn't get away...

mainline/songjiazhuang#44.zh: 朱仝战败，宋江没能脱身……
mainline/songjiazhuang#44.t: Zhu Tong was defeated, and Song Jiang couldn't get away...

mainline/songjiazhuang#45.zh: 雷横战败，宋江没能脱身……
mainline/songjiazhuang#45.t: Lei Heng was defeated, and Song Jiang couldn't get away...
